name: paperclip
description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
one_liner: A dashboard that lets you 'hire' a team of AI coding and work agents, give them goals and budgets, and watch and steer them from your phone like a task manager for a company of bots.
buyer: A solo founder or small agency running several AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) at once who keeps losing track of what each one is doing, costing, and shipping.
business_use_cases: A one-person software agency runs a 'team' of coding agents on client projects and uses the dashboard to approve work and track spend per client.
A marketing consultant hires a team of writer/designer agents to produce a client's content calendar and reviews their output from a phone before it goes out.
A startup CTO enforces spending caps and audit logs across every agent touching production code, satisfying an investor's governance question.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted version with SSO, team billing, and higher usage tiers for agencies and startups.
Sell a curated marketplace of pre-built agent 'employee' templates (a CTO agent, a marketer agent) for a one-time fee.

steal_this: This weekend, stand up Paperclip for a single client project, hire two agents (an owner and a checker) against a real repo, and sell the finished 'reviewed change' as a fixed-price freelance gig.
